notes.title: by attending school 放在哪里？修饰范围与因果表达
notes.question: 原句把 by attending school 放在 gain real-life knowledge 后。我觉得应写成 gain real-life knowledge and handle matters easily in their daily lives by attending school。这样是不是更符合中文？
notes.original: People gain real-life knowledge by attending school and handle matters easily in their daily lives.
notes.alternative: People gain real-life knowledge and handle matters easily in their daily lives by attending school.
keyPoints: by + 动名词表示方式或手段，即‘通过做某事’。位置会影响读者首先把它与哪个动作联系起来，但不能仅凭就近原则断言唯一解释。
原句中 by attending school 位于第一个并列谓语内，最自然地修饰 gain real-life knowledge；and 连接两个动作，本身没有把‘从而’这一因果关系写明。
你的后置写法有道理：句末状语在合适语境下可以覆盖两个并列动作。但它也可能被读成主要修饰 handle matters，并不能保证消除歧义。
如果想强调上学同时带来两种益处，可把 By attending school 放在句首；如果想强调知识帮助处理日常事务，宜直接写出因果关系。
notes.grammar: 原句结构：People [gain real-life knowledge by attending school] and [handle matters easily in their daily lives]。两个谓语共享主语 People。用户改写把方式状语置于整个并列结构之后，存在宽范围与局部范围解读。句首 By attending school, people ... and ... 更容易提示共同的方式背景；which helps them ... 则明确‘获得知识 → 更好处理日常事务’。这里不宜把中文词序直接当成英文状语位置的规则。
notes.improved: By attending school, people gain practical knowledge, which helps them deal more effectively with everyday problems.
notes.translation: 人们通过上学获得实用知识，这有助于他们更有效地应对日常问题。

examples.english: By attending school, people gain practical knowledge and develop skills for everyday life.
examples.chinese: 通过上学，人们获得实用知识，并培养日常生活所需的技能。（强调共同方式）

examples.english: Attending school equips people with practical knowledge, enabling them to deal more effectively with everyday problems.
examples.chinese: 上学使人们掌握实用知识，从而能更有效地应对日常问题。（强调因果）
